title: Fortalitium Fidei
shelf_note: A 1487 gothic-type incunable of Alfonso de Espina's anti-heretical treatise. It belongs on a medieval-literature shelf (arlima) and in a patron collection.
structure_note: The structure counts disagree: pages_translated is 0 but pages_translated_field is 504. That looks like a counting fault, because this page is translated. Only 26 of 506 pages carry a printed number, which is expected for a largely unfoliated incunable. On that small base, 10 backsteps and 13 repeats are most likely misread running heads, signatures or OCR <page-num> tags, not a scan splice. This leaf shows only the running head 'Liber | Secundus' and a 'Digitized by Google' stamp.

pages.layout: two columns of gothic type, running head 'Liber | Secundus' split across the columns, a three-line rubric heading and a large woodcut-style initial V in column 1, 'Digitized by Google' stamp at the foot

book_verdict: This page is the right leaf, and both the transcription and the English are sound for a heavily abbreviated incunable. Three abbreviation misreadings (Dicimus→Diceret, Vestra→vita, Sciendum→Secundum) pass into the English, and one note repeats a misreading as the original wording. None is serious.
